dedupe_keys.name: odre open data reseaux energies open data platform of french electricity and gas network operators

description: ODRÉ, Open Data Réseaux Énergies, is the shared open data platform of French energy network operators, run on Opendatasoft, where RTE, NaTran (formerly GRTgaz), Teréga, GRDF, Storengy, Elengy, Dunkerque LNG, Enedis and others publish data. The catalogue API listed 187 data sets on the day of cataloguing, and a search for gas returned 103. Gas data sets read include the simplified NaTran network trace, 10 and 20 km corridors around transmission and distribution networks, departmental pipeline lengths, hourly and daily gas consumption of industrial sites and public distribution interfaces, daily stocks and flows of gas storage since November 2010, daily LNG stocks at terminals, biomethane injection capacity and hourly production, reverse-flow sites, the Ecogaz signal and the joint works programme of gas operators, updated as recently as 26 September 2026. Electricity data sets include the national register of production and storage installations and RTE network data. Each data set can be filtered, viewed and exported through the portal or API. Coverage is France. The data sets read are free under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0. Caveats: data sets have different owners, update rates and precision, and some older ones have not been refreshed since 2019 to 2021. Simulation uses are French gas and electricity network models, demand and storage time series, and exposure of energy networks. Related records: data-natran-gas-transmission-network-trace-france and data-rte-transmission-sites-and-lines-france are data sets hosted on it.
